caption: The drawing depicts two views of a metal lantern. The main object in the center dominates the composition, shown in full detail and colored with various shades of brown and gray, with darker and lighter areas indicating metallic reflection and wear. The lantern has a cylindrical body with a slightly wavy top and bottom edge, and its surface is decorated with rows of small holes and punched designs arranged in geometric and curved patterns. It is fitted with an arched wire handle at the top, attached to side loops, which also holds a central cylindrical mechanism. In the upper right corner of the drawing, a smaller view of the same lantern is shown in profile, revealing a rectangular shape with a curved handle and a hinged opening on the front, while the same hole patterns and metal texture are visible. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the lanterns.
title: Storm Lamp
